vi.sub: Dong bo truoc roi xem ket luan

zh.sub: 同步完成后主结论为 ready，当前无阻断或提示项，可按标准节奏推进。

en.sub: After sync, the top-level conclusion is ready with no blockers or advisories, so standard flow can proceed.

vi.main: Trang thai Command Center Sync: READY_AFTER_SYNC
vi.sub: Sau dong bo, ket luan tong la ready va khong co blocker hay advisory, co the tiep tuc theo quy trinh chuan.

syncSubcopy.zh: 同步层已完成本轮汇总，当前值班口径可先以同步结果为准。
syncSubcopy.en: The sync layer has completed this round of aggregation, so duty judgment can start from the synced result.
syncSubcopy.vi: Lop dong bo da hoan tat tong hop cho lan nay, vi vay co the bat dau phan doan truc tu ket qua dong bo.

latestSubcopy.zh: latest 层无需额外纠偏，当前可直接沿结论进入动作执行。
latestSubcopy.en: The latest layer does not need extra correction, so operators can move directly from conclusion to action.
latestSubcopy.vi: Lop latest khong can hieu chinh them, nen co the chuyen truc tiep tu ket luan sang hanh dong.

firstAction.zh: 先确认 generatedAt 属于当前同步轮次，再执行正式放行并同步值班结论。
firstAction.en: Confirm generatedAt belongs to the current sync run first, then execute formal release and sync the duty conclusion.
firstAction.vi: Xac nhan generatedAt thuoc lan dong bo hien tai truoc, sau do phat hanh chinh thuc va dong bo ket luan truc.

zh.sub: 同步完成后仍存在阻断结论或阻断原因，当前应停止直接发布。

en.sub: Even after sync, blocking conclusion or reasons remain, so direct release should stop now.

vi.main: Trang thai Command Center Sync: BLOCKED_AFTER_SYNC
vi.sub: Ngay ca sau dong bo van con ket luan chan hoac ly do chan, nen phai dung phat hanh truc tiep luc nay.

syncSubcopy.zh: 同步并未消除阻断，说明问题已进入总汇总层，需按正式阻断处理。
syncSubcopy.en: Sync did not clear the blocker, which means the issue has reached the aggregated layer and must be treated as a formal block.
syncSubcopy.vi: Dong bo khong xoa duoc blocker, dieu nay cho thay van de da len den lop tong hop va phai duoc xu ly nhu mot chan chinh thuc.

latestSubcopy.zh: latest 层仍提示不可放行，不要跳过总卡片直接按单点结果放行。
latestSubcopy.en: The latest layer still says release is not allowed, so do not bypass the overview card based on a single point result.
latestSubcopy.vi: Lop latest van cho thay khong duoc phat hanh, vi vay khong duoc bo qua the tong quan chi vi mot ket qua don le.

firstAction.zh: 先处理 reasons 首项，再重跑 release-command-center-sync 确认阻断是否解除。
firstAction.en: Resolve the first item in reasons, then rerun release-command-center-sync to confirm whether the block is cleared.
firstAction.vi: Xu ly muc dau trong reasons, sau do chay lai release-command-center-sync de xac nhan blocker da duoc go hay chua.

conditions: advisories.length > 0 OR generatedAt is missing OR generatedAt == ''

vi.main: Can ra soat sau dong bo
vi.sub: Dong bo truoc roi xem canh bao

zh.sub: 同步完成后主结论虽为 GO，但仍有提示项或时间证据不足，需人工复核。

en.sub: After sync, the top-level conclusion is GO, but advisories remain or time evidence is insufficient, so manual review is needed.

vi.main: Trang thai Command Center Sync: REVIEW_REQUIRED_AFTER_SYNC
vi.sub: Sau dong bo, ket luan tong la GO nhung van con advisory hoac bang chung thoi gian chua du, can ra soat thu cong.

syncSubcopy.zh: 同步链路已跑通，但当前更适合把它视为已汇总待复核，而不是直接放行。
syncSubcopy.en: The sync chain has completed, but the safer interpretation is aggregated-for-review rather than directly releasable.
syncSubcopy.vi: Chuoi dong bo da chay xong, nhung cach hieu an toan hon la da tong hop de ra soat, khong phai de phat hanh ngay.

latestSubcopy.zh: latest 层提示仍需人工确认，不要把 GO 误读成可立即发布。
latestSubcopy.en: The latest layer still requires human confirmation, so do not read GO as immediate release.
latestSubcopy.vi: Lop latest van yeu cau xac nhan thu cong, vi vay khong duoc hieu GO la co the phat hanh ngay.

firstAction.zh: 先核对 advisories 与 generatedAt，再决定是否进入正式放行。
firstAction.en: Verify advisories and generatedAt first, then decide whether to enter formal release.
firstAction.vi: Kiem tra advisories va generatedAt truoc, sau do moi quyet dinh co vao buoc phat hanh chinh thuc hay khong.
